title: percolate-store
description:
Vendored + drift-gated schema for a consumer-owned percolation store (a declarative YAML config describing what a single publish target wants scrubbed/transformed by claude-klabauter's generic percolation engine). The store is data, never engine code — see coordinator_core/percolate/store.py for the loader/validator and coordinator_core/percolate/tests/test_store.py for the drift-gate test. A store has a `base` section (shared across all targets) plus a `targets` map (per-target overrides/composition). Cross-field invariants this schema cannot express structurally (single-placeholder-per-codename, full-name-sibling-fires-first, idempotency self-check) are enforced in store.py at load time, not by this JSON Schema shape alone.

Spec backlink: claude-klabauter:pln-percolation-engine-for-claude-klabauter--30c51f § Store schema (C1).

schema_version.description: Optional store-side schema_version assertion, checked against x-schema-version by the generic frontmatter version gate (refuse-on-newer-read).

base.description: Shared transform content and hook-set membership applied to every target before per-target overrides are composed in.

targets.description: Map of target-name -> per-target override section. Composed on top of `base` (see store.py resolve_target). Each target also declares its own hook-set membership (which transform-kinds run for this target) — composition covers both substitution content and hook-set membership, not just which keys apply.

hooks.description: Hook-set membership for this section — which transform-kinds run for the composed target. Valid entries are the taxonomy's transform-kind names (substitute, stem-rewrite, path-rewrite, basename-rename, depersonalize, sentinel-strip, file-surface, preserve-destination-native, inject, guard, prune-dead-registrations).

substitute.description: Exact-substitution entries (§ transform-kind `substitute`). Longest-match-first ordering is engine-derived (by key length), never store-declared.

sentinel_strip.description: Marker-pair entries (§ transform-kind `sentinel-strip`) — each names a start/end HTML-comment sentinel pair whose enclosed block (inclusive of both markers) is removed from every swept file before any other content transform runs. Registers a NEW marker pair for this target/base; the engine ships no built-in default pair — a target that wants a pair stripped must declare it here AND list `sentinel-strip` in `hooks`.

stem_rewrite.description: stem -> placeholder map for the boundary-free glued-identifier pass (§ transform-kind `stem-rewrite`).

discovery_scan_dir.description: Directory to scan at runtime for entries not covered by the static seed.

basename_rename.description: old->new basename pairs (§ transform-kind `basename-rename`). Applied last, after all content substitution.

depersonalize.description: Codename/persona entries with the three-class token discriminator (§ Store schema `Depersonalize token-class discriminator`). Every first-name entry must have a full-name sibling that sorts before it in longest-match-first order — enforced by store.py, not by this shape schema.

items.description: Basename only — must not contain a path separator (`/` or `\`). Documents the no-separator constraint enforced by claude-klabauter's `validate_store_dict` (claude-klabauter-em memo, parity confirmed).

basename_allowlist.description: Dest-only basenames (no `/`) to back up before delete-sync and restore after.

items.description: Basename only — must not contain a path separator (`/` or `\`). Documents the no-separator constraint enforced by claude-klabauter's `validate_store_dict` (claude-klabauter-em memo, parity confirmed).

sentinel_home_override.description: Optional override of the sentinel path root. Engine derives a generic consumer-state-home default when absent. MUST NOT be a hard-coded consumer-home literal in engine code — this field is the only place a concrete home path may live, and it lives in store data, not the engine.

inject.description: Injection source->dest sets with required-child invariants, applied after the delete pass.

match_mode.description: auto (default): ASCII key -> word-boundary, non-ASCII or slash-bearing key -> plain literal. Store may pin explicitly.

case_variants.description: When true, the engine generates ascii/upper/lower/title case-variants from this one canonical entry rather than requiring N hand-authored rows.

case_variant_placeholders.description: Opt-in, case-PRESERVING sibling of case_variants (requires case_variants:true on the same entry). When true, each generated case-variant row's `value` is transformed through the SAME case-variant kind (ascii/upper/lower/title) as its `key`, instead of every generated row sharing this entry's single `value` verbatim. Default false preserves today's shared-value collapse byte-for-byte -- existing case_variants:true stores are unaffected.

functional_hold.description: When true, this key is skipped on parsed-value line shapes (the sid<->session_id collision class).

excluded_contexts.description: Named exclusion contexts where this key must not fire.

start_marker.description: Literal opening sentinel line (e.g. an HTML comment) that begins a block to strip. Matched literally (not as a regex) against file content.

end_marker.description: Literal closing sentinel line that ends the block. The block is removed inclusive of both markers, non-greedy (a file may contain multiple independent start/end pairs; each is stripped individually).

token_class.description: attribution: KEEP verbatim (never substituted). vocabulary: REWRITE. mixed: functional identifier at some sites, provenance codename at others -- a mixed entry flagged private MUST be refused/escalated, never default-kept.

private.description: True when this codename names a private, non-public repo/system. A private+mixed entry is refused and escalated for manual review by store.py -- it is not a valid engine-resolvable entry.

full_name_sibling_of.description: When this entry is a bare first-name/short-handle rule, names the sibling `key` of the full-name entry that must fire first (longest-match-first). Prevents the Copyright-line corruption class (bare first-name rewrite inside `Copyright (c) 2026 <Full Name>`).

case_variants.description: When true, case-variants are engine-generated from this canonical entry and MUST all resolve to this same placeholder (single-placeholder-per-codename invariant), UNLESS case_variant_placeholders is also set (see below).

case_variant_placeholders.description: Opt-in, case-PRESERVING sibling of case_variants (requires case_variants:true on the same entry). When true, each generated case-variant row's `placeholder` is transformed through the SAME case-variant kind (ascii/upper/lower/title) as its `key`, instead of every generated row sharing this entry's single `placeholder` verbatim -- closes the case-collapse gap the DoE store's cockpit/claude-klabauter/example-voice-system entries flagged (`Cockpit` collapsing to lowercase `cockpit` instead of `Cockpit`). Default false preserves today's shared-placeholder collapse byte-for-byte; deliberately bypasses the single-placeholder-per-codename invariant's cross-case equality for THIS entry's own generated rows (that invariant still guards divergent HAND-AUTHORED entries for the same codename).

mode.description: Write policy for this entry. 'overwrite' (default, absent) copies unconditionally (idempotent by overwrite-converges). 'create-if-absent' copies only when dst is absent (idempotent by absence-skip); a pre-existing dst is left untouched.

condition_present.description: Optional path (relative to target_root). When set, this entry is injected only if that path exists; otherwise it is skipped entirely.

params.description: Check-specific parameters (paths, patterns, override-env names). Shape varies per kind; validated by the guard engine, not this schema. For 'no-residual-pattern', either params.pattern (static literal) or params.pattern_source (opaque descriptor resolved at runtime by an injected resolver), never both. params.pattern_source may additionally carry an optional `no_exempt` key: a list of registry slugs to RE-ADMIT from the global KEEPSET for THIS target only (i.e. this target's leak check will flag those codenames even though they're globally exempt elsewhere). Each listed slug MUST already be a KEEPSET member -- a non-member slug raises at resolve time. Re-admitted matching is case-insensitive and separator-insensitive across underscore/hyphen and upper/lower/title forms (e.g. `doe_claude`, `doe-claude`, `DOE_CLAUDE` all match the same re-admission). Polarity is opt-out: a target that omits `no_exempt` (or omits `pattern_source` entirely) silently inherits the full global exemption -- no action needed to keep today's behavior.

severity.description: 'error' (default, absent) — the guard's ok result contributes to pass/fail. 'info' — advisory only; run_guard forces ok=true regardless of the check outcome, carrying any finding in message, so an informational guard can never flip a consumer's aggregate gate. severity governs ONLY the returned ok/pass-fail contribution, never whether the check kind performs a side effect: for the one side-effecting kind ('prune-stale-paths', which deletes paths as its check action), severity 'info' is REJECTED (GuardCheckError) rather than silently accepted, because it always deletes before severity is even consulted -- an 'info' entry on it cannot mean 'don't delete'.

override_env.description: Name of an environment variable that, when set, bypasses this guard.
